CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsDate

Returns YES if the value is a date/time object or a string that KoldFusion can read as a date, such as "12/31/1999" or "January 1, 2000".

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsDate(string)

Parameters

string
Any value, usually a string.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Impossible dates such as "February 30, 2000" return NO. Plain numbers, including strings like "2000", return NO even though they could be read as a date serial number; use IsNumericDate for those. Use ParseDateTime or CreateODBCDate to turn a valid string into a date. LSIsDate checks locale-specific formats.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "12/31/1999|January 1, 2000|2000-02-29|February 30, 2000|2000|next Tuesday">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>string</TH><TH>IsDate</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="s" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#s#</TD><TD>#IsDate(s)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>Now()</TD><TD>#IsDate(Now())#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

IsNumericDate, ParseDateTime, LSIsDate, CreateDate
